title: Your First Weekend at Fordham University, Shared as Cards
description: A low-key, under-21-safe Rose Hill sequence that starts with orientation and campus bearings, then leaves room for study, reflection, clubs, and an evening coffeehouse stop.

cards.title: Start with orientation
cards.subtitle: First stop: Rose Hill orientation
cards.notes: Use the official orientation schedule to find your group, ask where key offices are, and introduce yourself to someone in your session.
cards.short_summary: Fordham frames Rose Hill orientation as a resource-and-connection starting point for new students.
cards.evidence_claim: Fordham says Rose Hill orientation helps new students learn about resources and meet people, with fall orientation scheduled for August 22–25, 2026.
cards.source_title: Student Orientation at Rose Hill | Fordham
cards.access_notes: Follow the current Orientation Guidebook schedule and instructions from Fordham.

cards.title: Get your bearings on foot
cards.subtitle: Next: a self-paced campus loop
cards.notes: Take the self-guided route at an easy pace and mark the buildings you will actually use during your first week.
cards.short_summary: A guided route offers a practical first pass through Rose Hill’s core spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Fordham offers a year-round Rose Hill self-guided tour, generally available on weekdays and most weekends, with preset walking trails.
cards.access_notes: Registration windows and availability vary; use Fordham’s visit page before setting out.

cards.title: Pause on Eddie's Parade
cards.subtitle: A central outdoor reset
cards.notes: Meet your new group outside for a few minutes, then use the open space as a landmark before heading to the next building.
cards.short_summary: Orientation materials depict new students gathering on Eddie’s Parade.
cards.evidence_claim: Fordham’s Rose Hill orientation page identifies Eddie’s Parade as the setting for groups of students during New Student Orientation.
cards.source_title: Student Orientation at Rose Hill | Fordham
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access and programming depend on current campus conditions and schedules.

cards.title: Find Keating Hall
cards.subtitle: A recognizable Rose Hill landmark
cards.notes: Walk up to Keating, note its entrances, and snap a reference photo so you can navigate confidently when classes begin.
cards.short_summary: Keating anchors the campus scene shown in Fordham’s Rose Hill visit materials.
cards.evidence_claim: Fordham’s visit page features students relaxing and walking on the grass in front of Keating Hall at Rose Hill.
cards.access_notes: Use the current Rose Hill campus map and observe building-entry rules.

cards.title: Set up a library fallback
cards.subtitle: Study stop: Walsh Library at Rose Hill
cards.notes: Locate a floor you would be comfortable using between classes, then save the library hours page for changes during the term.
cards.short_summary: Walsh Library provides a dependable academic stop with regular-session evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Fordham lists Walsh Library at Rose Hill and posts regular-session hours through midnight Monday through Thursday and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Regular-session hours shown are Mon–Thu 8:30 a.m.–12 a.m. and Sun 10 a.m.–12 a.m.; Fordham notes hours may change.

cards.title: Step into University Church
cards.subtitle: A quiet Rose Hill landmark
cards.notes: If a service is underway, follow posted guidance; otherwise, use the church area as a calm point to regroup and orient yourself.
cards.short_summary: The University Church is a listed Rose Hill sacred space and a site for campus liturgies.
cards.evidence_claim: Fordham lists University Church among Rose Hill sacred spaces and posts summer Sunday Mass there at 10 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Check Fordham Campus Ministry’s current schedule; the cited page lists summer Sunday Mass at 10 a.m.

cards.title: Try a low-pressure club meeting
cards.subtitle: Activity option: Chess Club
cards.notes: Use Rams Involved to confirm the next meeting, then arrive ready to play one casual game and ask how beginners can participate.
cards.short_summary: Chess Club offers a straightforward way to meet peers around a shared activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Fordham’s Rose Hill organization directory says Chess Club provides weekly peer play and hosts internal and intercollegiate tournaments.
cards.access_notes: Meeting details require student access to Rams Involved or confirmation from the organization.

cards.title: Check the weekend program
cards.subtitle: Activity option: Campus Activities Board
cards.notes: Look for the next CAB weekend listing and choose a campus or city activity whose time, meeting point, and requirements are clearly posted.
cards.short_summary: CAB’s Weekend Activities Committee plans recurring weekend programming and excursions.
cards.evidence_claim: Fordham says the Campus Activities Board’s Weekend Activities Committee provides weekend programming on and off campus, ranging from bingo to excursions.
cards.source_title: Rose Hill Campus Activities Board | Fordham
cards.access_notes: Dates, destinations, registration, and any costs vary by program; verify the current CAB announcement.

cards.entity_name: Joseph M. McShane, S.J. Campus Center
cards.title: Locate McShane Campus Center
cards.subtitle: A useful student-life waypoint
cards.notes: Find the main entrances and save the building on your map; it is a practical place to recognize before your first full week.
cards.short_summary: McShane Campus Center is a named Rose Hill destination on Fordham’s official map.
cards.evidence_claim: Fordham’s official Rose Hill Campus Map lists McShane Campus Center as a campus building.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current building access and event locations through Fordham before visiting.

cards.title: End at Rodrigue's
cards.subtitle: Evening option: Alumni House
cards.notes: Confirm that night’s programming, then stop in for an open mic, creative event, or a quiet drink-free coffeehouse visit with classmates.
cards.short_summary: Rodrigue’s combines coffeehouse service with student-planned creative programming in Alumni House.
cards.evidence_claim: Fordham identifies Rodrigue’s as its student-run coffee house in Alumni House and lists open mics, arts events, and regular evening hours.
cards.source_title: Rose Hill Campus Activities Board | Fordham
cards.access_notes: Fordham lists Mon–Thu and Sun hours until 12 a.m.; confirm current hours and event access before going.
